- name: Ensure PR references an issue
  run: |
    python3 <<'EOF'
    import json, re, sys
    with open(os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_PATH']) as f:
        evt = json.load(f)
    pr = evt['pull_request']
    title = pr['title']
    body = pr['body'] or ''
    if re.search(r'#\d+', title) or re.search(r'#\d+', body):
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        sys.exit(1)
    EOF
